enrichment-abilities.json.name: Fail-safe Detonator
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] Used when a Battlesuit model is destroyed: if it has Deadly Demise, choose the roll result to be 1 or 6 instead of rolling; otherwise roll one D6 per unit within 6" and on a 4+ that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Encoded as an opaque grant.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Grav-Inhibitor Field
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Used just after an enemy unit declares a charge against the Battlesuit unit: that enemy unit takes a Battle-shock test and you roll one D6 per model in it, suffering 1 mortal wound per 6.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: The Arro'kon Protocol
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Applies only against enemy units containing 6 or more models; against units of 11 or more models the attacks gain [SUSTAINED HITS 2] instead. The model-count scaling is not encoded.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: The Shortened Blade
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: A unit arriving via Deep Strike can be set up more than 6" horizontally from all enemy models; it cannot declare a charge this turn.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: The Torchstar Gambit
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: After its attacks are resolved, an unengaged unit can make a Normal move but cannot declare a charge this turn.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Aggressive Mobility
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: If the unit Advances, no Advance roll is made; instead add 6" to the Move characteristic of its models until the end of the phase.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Combat Debarkation
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Applies only to attacks that target the closest enemy unit; the closest-target gate is not encoded.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Focused Fire
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Targets two T'au Empire units and one enemy unit: both units can only attack that enemy unit this phase, with AP improved by 1. Cannot be used in the fourth or fifth battle rounds.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Pinpoint Counter-Offensive
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Used on a just-destroyed T'au Empire unit (excluding Kroot): for the rest of the battle, T'au Empire units (excluding Kroot) re-roll Hit rolls against the enemy unit that destroyed it.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Pulse Onslaught
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: The selected enemy unit (excluding Monsters and Vehicles) hit by this unit's attacks is shaken until the end of your opponent's next turn.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: A Trap Well Laid
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Applies to attacks made by Kroot models against the selected unit, unless the attacking unit is Battle-shocked.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: EMP Grenades
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Worsens the Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill characteristics of the selected enemy Vehicle unit's weapons by 1 (higher is worse).

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Hidden Hunters
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: The unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Join the Hunt
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] Used on a just-destroyed Kroot Infantry or Kroot Hounds unit: add an identical unit to your army in Strategic Reserves at Starting Strength. Cannot return destroyed Character units to Attached units. Encoded as an opaque grant.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: The Grisly Feast
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Used on a unit that destroyed an enemy unit this Fight phase: in the opponent's next Command phase each enemy unit within 6" takes a Battle-shock test (-1 if Below Half-strength) and skips its other Battle-shock tests that phase.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: A Tempting Trap
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: The first use designates one objective marker outside the opponent's deployment zone as your Trap objective; the bonus applies only to ranged attacks against enemy units within range of it. Cannot be used in the first or second battle rounds.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Combat Embarkation
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] Used just after an enemy unit declares a charge against this unit: the unit embarks within a friendly Transport if every model is within 3" of it and capacity suffices. Encoded as an opaque grant.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Coordinate to Engage
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Used on a unit just selected as an Observer: its attacks against their Spotted unit have Ballistic Skill improved by 1 and, if the unit has Markerlight, [IGNORES COVER].

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Photon Grenades
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Used just after an enemy unit declares a charge against this unengaged unit: the charging unit takes a Battle-shock test and has -2 to Charge rolls this phase.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Point-Blank Ambush
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Applies only to ranged attacks against enemy units within 9"; cannot be used in the first or second battle rounds.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Wall of Mirrors
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: At the end of the opponent's Fight phase, one unengaged Stealth, Ghostkeel or Commander Shadowsun unit is placed into Strategic Reserves.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Alien Expertise
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Kroot or Vespid Stingwings unit only; the Advance move does not prevent the unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Experimental Modifications
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Kroot or Vespid Stingwings unit only; applies to the unit's attacks when selected to attack in the Shooting or Fight phase.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Guided By Unity
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Applies only to ranged attacks against units within 9" of a friendly Kroot or Vespid Stingwings unit; the proximity gate is not encoded. Cannot target Kroot or Vespid Stingwings units.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Rapid Acquisition
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: At the end of your Movement phase, one objective the unit controls becomes secured.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Suppressing Fire
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: One enemy unit hit by this unit's attacks is pinned (-2" Move) until the start of your next Command phase.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Swift Embarkation
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: At the end of the opponent's Fight phase, an unengaged unit that was eligible to fight, wholly within 6" of a friendly Sudden Dawn Cadre Transport it can embark within, embarks within it.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Puretide Engram Neurochip
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Each time you target the bearer's unit with a Stratagem, roll one D6: on a 4+ you gain 1 CP.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Starflare Ignition System
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: At the end of the opponent's turn, if the bearer's unit is unengaged, it can be removed from the battlefield and placed into Strategic Reserves.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Internal Grenade Racks
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: The mortal wounds trigger each time the bearer ends a Normal move, against one enemy unit it moved over: roll six D6, 1 mortal wound per 4+.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Prototype Weapon System
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Selected each time the bearer is selected to shoot; applies to the bearer's ranged weapons until those attacks are resolved.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Exemplar of the Mont'ka
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: While the bearer is leading a unit, the Killing Blow detachment rule applies to that unit during the fourth battle round as well. Kroot Shaper models cannot take this.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Strike Swiftly
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: In the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step, up to two friendly T'au Empire units within 6" that lack Scouts gain the Scouts 6" ability.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Strategic Conqueror
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] At the start of the first battle round select one objective marker; while the bearer is on the battlefield, friendly T'au Empire models within range of it get +1 Objective Control. Encoded as an opaque grant.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Coordinated Exploitation
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] While the bearer is leading a unit, each time that unit is an Observer, ranged weapons of a Guided unit gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1] while targeting their Spotted unit. Encoded as an opaque grant. Kroot Shaper models cannot take this.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Kroothawk Flock
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Enemy units arriving as Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" horizontally of the bearer; encoded as an opaque grant.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Root-carved Weapons
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Applies to all weapons equipped by the bearer.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Borthrod Gland
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: While the bearer is leading a unit, melee attacks made by models in that unit score Critical Hits on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Supernova Launcher
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Applies to one Airbursting Fragmentation Projector selected in the Declare Battle Formations step; the weapon-name scoping is not encoded.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Thermoneutronic Projector
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Applies to one T'au Flamer selected in the Declare Battle Formations step; the weapon-name scoping is not encoded.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Plasma Accelerator Rifle
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: Applies to one Plasma Rifle selected in the Declare Battle Formations step; the weapon-name scoping is not encoded.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Exemplar of the Kauyon
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: While the bearer is leading a unit, the Patient Hunter detachment rule applies to that unit from the second battle round instead of the third. Kroot Shaper models cannot take this.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Precision of the Patient Hunter
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: From the third battle round onwards, also add 1 to the Wound roll; the round-gated wound bonus is not encoded.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Solid-image Projection Unit
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: After deployment, redeploy up to three T'au Empire units, optionally into Strategic Reserves regardless of the usual limits.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Through Unity, Devastation
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] While the bearer is leading a unit, each time that unit is an Observer, ranged weapons of a Guided unit gain [LETHAL HITS] while targeting their Spotted unit. Encoded as an opaque grant. Kroot Shaper models cannot take this.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Student of Kauyon
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] In the Declare Battle Formations step, up to three friendly Kroot Carnivores or Farstalker Kinband units gain Deep Strike. Encoded as an opaque grant.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Admired Leader
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: In your Command phase, one Kroot or Vespid Stingwings unit within 12" gets improved Leadership (encoded as -1, lower is better) and +1 Objective Control until the start of your next Command phase. Kroot models cannot take this.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Earth Caste Modifications
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] After this unit shoots, one enemy unit hit is suppressed (-1 to Hit rolls) until the start of your next turn; and this unit's ingress moves can be set up more than 6" (instead of 8") from enemies at the cost of not charging that turn. Both encoded as opaque grants.

enrichment-abilities.json.name: Proximity Scanners
enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] Unit Upgrade (Devilfish unit, not a Character Enhancement): when a friendly unit disembarks from this unit, its pulse blaster and pulse carbine weapons get +1 Attacks. Encoded as an opaque grant.
